name: tilttek/seasonal-events
description: Seasons and their events for gamification: a season that comes once or each year by an RFC 5545 rule, in its timezone, the quests, items and decorations it and its events bring while they last, multipliers of gains only on events announced ahead, a port the other packages read what is on through, and optional bridges to tilttek/quests and tilttek/collections

suggest.tilttek/collections: To list the items of a collections catalog the seasons bring, with Bridge\Collections\SeasonalItems
suggest.tilttek/quests: To open a quest with a season or one of its events, with Bridge\Quests\SeasonQuestSchedule
